scope: One task-conditioned MAS generator with shared cross-benchmark experience, not a separate selected generator per benchmark
development_partition: Removed; existing EVO/VAL preserved; former RR and DSQA Dev join TEST inventory

exposures.researchrubrics: All 18 formerly quarantined rows remain labelled in TEST. Only the original 33 clean rows support primary independent-test claims
exposures.writingbench: Author index 1 was partially exposed by a parser error while preparing metadata; its entire duplicate group is assigned to EVO before stratification
exposures.meaning: Clean means no recorded project development exposure, not a claim about foundation-model pretraining contamination

evolution.stores: One shared mutable store per joint replicate
evolution.order: Within each stage, repeat RR, (DSQA, WritingBench) x5 five times; preserve frozen within-source run order
evolution.updates: Direct per-source writes after existing structural/evidence checks; no accept/hold/reject quality gate
evolution.failures: Consume source positions once; no replacement or repeated source sampling
evolution.continuation: Always latest trajectory state; no rollback or early stopping based on VAL
evolution.retrieval: Benchmark-agnostic applicability retrieval; all experience source IDs must belong to global EVO; exclude global VAL and TEST

validation.scope: The complete fixed 220-task union at every checkpoint, not the recent batch or an expanding window

native_score_normalization.researchrubrics: (score-L_t)/(U_t-L_t); native task-theoretical bounds fixed before responses; degenerate range maps to 0

validation.aggregation: Mean normalized task-repeat utility within benchmark, then three benchmarks equally weighted 1/3 each
validation.missing: Observed native score stays null; normalized selection surrogate substitutes 0 for every missing slot
validation.eligibility: All three benchmark-specific 90% thresholds must pass
validation.selection: All seven whole-state checkpoints including C0; global max utility, tolerance 1e-12, then more complete slots, earlier source position, lexical state hash
validation.isolation: Read-only snapshots, no attribution/write, no VAL feedback supplied to source actors or human mid-run tuning
validation.cache: Identical state and execution identity reuse prior VAL observations; no repeated sampling for a higher score

universal_generator_release.checkpoint: The run-0 joint-VAL winner; no eligible winner means no release, not fallback to a favorable replicate
universal_generator_release.replicates: Runs 1 and 2 are robustness replicates; all three are reported, no TEST-based run choice
required_components: dataset, split, protocol and checkpoint journal hashes
not_claimed: One fixed MAS team used for all tasks
A deployed final version before evolution has run
universal_generator_release.test_binding: For each run, all six benchmarks must use the identical selected state and generator/config identity; benchmark adapters differ only for task input and scoring

test.release_boundary: Seal all registered six-benchmark submissions before any TEST judging/feedback release
test.adaptation: No target tuning, experience updates, checkpoint/source switching, or extra inter-agent discussion
test.instruction_track: Single-turn IFEval and IFBench with no checker-guided response repair

comparison.matching: Same backbone, input evidence, and common resource ceilings per task; actual cost reported
comparison.ablations: No explicit rubrics / global-only planning / global-only attribution use the same joint source/VAL opportunities; RR clean slice is the mechanism endpoint
comparison.guidance: RR G/GO uses the same joint-selected state and precommitted quality guidance

evaluation.researchrubrics: Pinned signed-weight native rubric score; primary clean 33, exposed/reserved 18 separate
evaluation.deepsearchqa: Native task F1, precision/recall and fully-correct rate separate
evaluation.writingbench: Mean author checklist score 1-10 per task, then task macro mean; hidden checklist stays evaluator-only
evaluation.deepresearch_bench_ii: Fraction of native rubric labels equal to 1; blocked-source rate separate
evaluation.ifeval: Author prompt-level strict accuracy; loose and instruction-level scores auxiliary
evaluation.ifbench: Author prompt-level loose accuracy; strict and instruction-level scores auxiliary
evaluation.aggregate_policy: Native TEST scores reported separately, not the normalized VAL utility as a leaderboard score
evaluation.families: Four primary research/writing benchmarks; two instruction-following diagnostics reported as a separate family
evaluation.uncertainty: Whole-task paired bootstrap 10000, seed20261001; sign-flip100000 and Holm within preregistered families; between-trajectory variation reported separately
evaluation.failure_policy: No whole-task quality resampling; missing observed scores, completion and feasible bounds retained

execution_profile: Retain configs/benchmark_suite_v3.yaml model/resource limits; benchmark-specific scorer identities must be pinned in the run bundle
